3
Ɛyerenom ne kununom
1 # Efe 5.22 Saa ara na mo, ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo ara mo kununom, na sɛ ebinom antie asɛm no nso a, wɔafa ɛyerenom abrabɔ a asɛm nni ho so anya wɔn, 2sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mo abrabɔ a ɛho teɛ wɔ osuro mu. 3#Yes 3.18-24; 1 Ti 2.9 Mommma mo ahyehyɛdeɛ nnyɛ honam ani deɛ, mmɛsawɔ ne sikahyɛ anaa ntadehyɛ mu, 4na mmom momma no nyɛ akoma mu nipa a wahunta no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ, na ɛyɛ komm adeɛ a ɛmporɔ mu. Ɛno na ne boɔ yɛ den Nyankopɔn anim. 5Na saa na tete no mmaa kronkron a wɔde wɔn ho too Nyankopɔn soɔ no hyehyɛɛ wɔn ho, na wɔbrɛɛ wɔn ho ase maa wɔn ara wɔn kununom, 6#Gye 18.12 sɛdeɛ Sara tiee Abraham, frɛɛ no owura no. Ɔno na, sɛ moyɛ papa na monsuro ahudeɛ biara a, moyɛ ne mma.
7 # Efe 5.25 Okununom, mo ne wɔn ntena nimdeɛ mu saa ara, sɛ ɔyere ne adeɛ a ne ho nyɛ den, na monni wɔn ni, sɛ wɔn nso ne mo yɛ nkwa adom no adedifoɔ bi, na mo mpaebɔ kwan ansi.
Amanehunu wɔ teneneeyɛ mu
8N’awieeɛ ne sɛ mo nyinaa nnya adwenkorɔ, monhunu mmema mo ho, monnodɔ mo ho sɛ anuanom, mo yam nhyehye mo mmema mo ho, monnwene ahobrɛaseɛ adwene. 9#1 Te 5.15 Mommfa bɔne nntua bɔne ka, nso mommfa ɔyɛ nntua ɔyɛ ka; na mmom monhyira, ɛfiri sɛ yei mu na wɔafrɛ mo, sɛ mommɛgye nhyira. 10#Dwom 34.12-16; Yak 1.26 Na
deɛ ɔdɔ nkwa
na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhunu nna pa no,
ma no nyi ne tɛkyerɛma mfiri bɔne mu,
ne n’ano na anka nnaadaasɛm.
11Ma no nkyiri bɔne na ɔnyɛ papa,
ma no nhwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ na ɔnni akyire.
12Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wɔtene so,
na n’aso abue ama wɔn mpaebɔ,
na Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne.
13Na sɛ modi papa akyiri a, hwan na ɔbɛha mo? 14#1 Pe 2.20 Na sɛ tenenee nti mohunu amane nso a, nhyira ne mo. Na monnsuro wɔn ho hu, na mommma mo akoma nntu. 15#Yes 8.13 Na mommu Awurade Kristo kronkron wɔ mo akoma mu. Nso monsiesie mo ho daa, sɛ mobɛkyerɛ obiara a ɔbisa mo anidasoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no aseɛ, 16ɔdwoɔ ne suro mu, na monnya ahonim pa, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu no, wɔn a wɔgu mo abrabɔ pa a ɛwɔ Kristo mu no ho fi no ani awu. 17#1 Pe 3.14 Na sɛ ɔpɛ na Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ mohunu amane sɛ papayɛfoɔ a, ɛyɛ kyɛne sɛ mohunu sɛ bɔneyɛfoɔ.
18 # 1 Pe 2.21-24; Efe 2.18 Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu bɔne ho amane prɛko, deɛ ɔtene hunu maa wɔn a wɔntene, sɛ ɔde yɛn bɛkɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. Wɔkumm no honam mu, na wɔmaa no tenaa ase honhom mu. 19#1 Pe 4.6 Ɛno mu nso na ɔkɔ kɔkaa asɛm kyerɛɛ ahonhom a wɔwɔ afiase 20#Gye 7.7; 7.17 a tete no wɔyɛ asoɔdenfoɔ, ɛberɛ a Nyankopɔn abodwokyɛre twɛneeɛ, Noa nna a wɔreyɛ adaka no mu. Emu na akra kakraa bi a wɔn ano si baawɔtwe nyaa nkwa nsuo no mu. 21#Efe 5.26 Ɛno na afei ne nsɛsoɔ a ɛno ne asubɔ no, gye mo nso nkwa, a ɛnyɛ honam ho fi yi mu, na mmom ɛyɛ ahonim pa ho adebisa a Yesu Kristo wusɔreɛ nti yɛnam so yɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ. 22#Efe 1.20-21 Ɔno na ɔkɔɔ ɔsoro no, ɔte Nyankopɔn nifa, na abɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne tumi mu no abrɛ wɔn ho ase ama no.

Saa ara na mo, ɛyerenom, mommrɛ mo ho ase mma mo ara mo kununom, na sɛ ebinom antie asɛm no nso a, wɔafa ɛyerenom abrabɔ a asɛm nni ho so anya wɔn, sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mo abrabɔ a ɛho teɛ wɔ osuro mu. Mommma mo ahyehyɛdeɛ nnyɛ honam ani deɛ, mmɛsawɔ ne sikahyɛ anaa ntadehyɛ mu, na mmom momma no nyɛ akoma mu nipa a wahunta no, honhom a ɛdwoɔ, na ɛyɛ komm adeɛ a ɛmporɔ mu. Ɛno na ne boɔ yɛ den Nyankopɔn anim. Na saa na tete no mmaa kronkron a wɔde wɔn ho too Nyankopɔn soɔ no hyehyɛɛ wɔn ho, na wɔbrɛɛ wɔn ho ase maa wɔn ara wɔn kununom, sɛdeɛ Sara tiee Abraham, frɛɛ no owura no. Ɔno na, sɛ moyɛ papa na monsuro ahudeɛ biara a, moyɛ ne mma.
Okununom, mo ne wɔn ntena nimdeɛ mu saa ara, sɛ ɔyere ne adeɛ a ne ho nyɛ den, na monni wɔn ni, sɛ wɔn nso ne mo yɛ nkwa adom no adedifoɔ bi, na mo mpaebɔ kwan ansi.

N’awieeɛ ne sɛ mo nyinaa nnya adwenkorɔ, monhunu mmema mo ho, monnodɔ mo ho sɛ anuanom, mo yam nhyehye mo mmema mo ho, monnwene ahobrɛaseɛ adwene. Mommfa bɔne nntua bɔne ka, nso mommfa ɔyɛ nntua ɔyɛ ka; na mmom monhyira, ɛfiri sɛ yei mu na wɔafrɛ mo, sɛ mommɛgye nhyira. Na
deɛ ɔdɔ nkwa
na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhunu nna pa no,
ma no nyi ne tɛkyerɛma mfiri bɔne mu,
ne n’ano na anka nnaadaasɛm.
Ma no nkyiri bɔne na ɔnyɛ papa,
ma no nhwehwɛ asomdwoeɛ na ɔnni akyire.
Ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wɔtene so,
na n’aso abue ama wɔn mpaebɔ,
na Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne.
Na sɛ modi papa akyiri a, hwan na ɔbɛha mo? Na sɛ tenenee nti mohunu amane nso a, nhyira ne mo. Na monnsuro wɔn ho hu, na mommma mo akoma nntu. Na mommu Awurade Kristo kronkron wɔ mo akoma mu. Nso monsiesie mo ho daa, sɛ mobɛkyerɛ obiara a ɔbisa mo anidasoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no aseɛ, ɔdwoɔ ne suro mu, na monnya ahonim pa, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu no, wɔn a wɔgu mo abrabɔ pa a ɛwɔ Kristo mu no ho fi no ani awu. Na sɛ ɔpɛ na Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ mohunu amane sɛ papayɛfoɔ a, ɛyɛ kyɛne sɛ mohunu sɛ bɔneyɛfoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu bɔne ho amane prɛko, deɛ ɔtene hunu maa wɔn a wɔntene, sɛ ɔde yɛn bɛkɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn. Wɔkumm no honam mu, na wɔmaa no tenaa ase honhom mu. Ɛno mu nso na ɔkɔ kɔkaa asɛm kyerɛɛ ahonhom a wɔwɔ afiase a tete no wɔyɛ asoɔdenfoɔ, ɛberɛ a Nyankopɔn abodwokyɛre twɛneeɛ, Noa nna a wɔreyɛ adaka no mu. Emu na akra kakraa bi a wɔn ano si baawɔtwe nyaa nkwa nsuo no mu. Ɛno na afei ne nsɛsoɔ a ɛno ne asubɔ no, gye mo nso nkwa, a ɛnyɛ honam ho fi yi mu, na mmom ɛyɛ ahonim pa ho adebisa a Yesu Kristo wusɔreɛ nti yɛnam so yɛ Nyankopɔn deɛ. Ɔno na ɔkɔɔ ɔsoro no, ɔte Nyankopɔn nifa, na abɔfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne tumi mu no abrɛ wɔn ho ase ama no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
